::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** [<i>c</i>. 24 December 1855]  
**Manuscript:** MS location unknown . Photocopies lent by Barbara Dennis: Maggie/1
:::

My dear little [Maggie](people/person_83.qmd)
This is to wish you a very happy Christmas I think it must be happier than all the three Christmases before it, because you are old enough to know Who was born a little Baby and what the Angels came to sing while the Shepherds were watching by night.  Thank you for your pretty little note to me; and thank [Mamma](people/person_1019.qmd) and [Alice](people/person_1025.qmd) too for theirs.  I hope I shall see your holly next week.  I shall like so much to come.  I wonder whether you will have a hymn to say to me

My little Maggie’s very affectionate Godmother
Charlotte M Yonge
